name: arigami
description: One workspace for Claude Code and Codex: shared connections, memory and skills; a real machine in the cloud or yours; extensions written from the chat.

paragraphs: Arigami — the self-hosted cockpit for a team of coding agents (Claude Code or Codex) that runs on real desktops, hands you the wheel when it needs you, and learns your business only with your approval.
Website: arigami-site.vercel.app · Film (42 s): click the poster

whatItDoes.text: Arigami — the self-hosted cockpit for a team of coding agents (Claude Code or Codex) that runs on real desktops, hands you the wheel when it needs you, and learns your business only with your approval.

requirements.text: Prerequisites the installer handles for you: bun ≥ 1.2, git + gh, and the Claude Code CLI signed in with your own subscription — no API keys, no OpenRouter. (ANTHROPICAPIKEY works too if you prefer metered billing.) Codex instead or as well: npm i -g @openai/codex, then sign in with ChatGPT or an OpenAI API key — see Engines.

At login, 2FA, CAPTCHA or payment it pushes to your phone, you take over the screen, tap Done, and it continues — the human is in the loop exactly where the human is needed.
